finding: With Q4_K_M model weights, neither KV lane reliably answered three long-context questions in one structured JSON response. Q8 mostly repeated instructions or questions. Q4 produced one degenerate overlong evidence string and some incomplete answers.
decision: Do not claim a cache-quality difference from this floor result. Reduce only the output task to one short answer at a time while preserving the same long source contexts.
privacy: Raw conversations remain private. Public text contains only questions and model-produced answers.
